statement: One wired Xbox Series reference 045e:0b12 delivered the C9 xpad-style input controls through Linux xpad, including distinct Guide and Share, and resumed input after USB reconnect.

applicability.revision: One reference matching USB 045e:0b12; exact model unconfirmed
applicability.firmware: Unconfirmed; USB bcdDevice 5.17 and evdev version 0x0517 were observed
applicability.scope: Linux 7.3.0-1-mainline x86_64, post-driver evdev controls and one USB reconnect. C9 comparison covers identity and advertised control capabilities. Raw GIP, Bluetooth and physical outputs are outside this claim.
